name: Back to Billy
summary: Back to Billy is a step in the ongoing feud between the Stonefield and Maclure families in central Elwynn Forest. Having gathered the ingredients for a pork belly pie, you carry the freshly baked dish back to young Billy Maclure to extract information about Bernice Stonefield's missing necklace.

sections.title: A Bitter Pie
sections.body: The generational squabble between the Stonefields and the Maclures leaves little room for neighbourly grace. Auntie Bernice Stonefield reluctantly baked the requested pork belly pie only because young Billy Maclure refused to share what he knew about her family heirloom without it. Even as she hands over the warm pastry, her irritation is plain, bidding the courier to tell the Maclure boy she hopes he chokes on every bite.

sections.title: A Boy's Bribe
sections.body: Across the road at the Maclure Vineyards, Billy Maclure waits with an empty belly and a convenient lapse in memory. The exchange highlights the stubborn pettiness that divides the two homesteads, where even children learn to barter gossip and stolen trinkets for farm treats. With the pie delivered, Billy's memory conveniently clears up, setting up the search for the necklace's true location.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this delivery?
faq.answer: Billy Maclure claimed to know where Auntie Bernice Stonefield's lost necklace was, but refused to talk until he was given a home-cooked pork belly pie. Delivering the pie fulfills his demand so he will reveal where the heirloom went.

faq.q: Why is Auntie Bernice so upset with Billy?
faq.answer: The Stonefield and Maclure families have been locked in a bitter rural feud for years. Bernice resents having to cook a treat for a troublesome Maclure child just to recover an heirloom that went missing on their borders.

faq.q: Where does Billy say the necklace actually is?
faq.answer: Once Billy devours the pie, he reveals that he did not keep the necklace. Instead, it fell into the hands of Goldtooth, a notorious kobold lurking in the Fargodeep Mine.
Billy Maclure is located at the Maclure Vineyards, just south of the road in central Elwynn Forest, opposite the Stonefield Farm.

faq.q: Who baked the Pork Belly Pie?
faq.answer: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield baked the pie at the Stonefield Farm after you collected fresh chunks of boar meat from the nearby wilderness.

faq.q: Does this quest resolve the feud between the families?
faq.answer: No. Delivering the pie only satisfies Billy's personal bribe. The deep-seated animosity between the adult Stonefields and Maclures remains as bitter as ever.

angles.text: Even peaceful Elwynn Forest is plagued by mundane disputes; dealing with squabbling human farmsteads is typical duty for travelers aiding the local folk.
Pork belly pie is a quintessential Elwynn farmhouse comfort dish, made from the meat of the forest's roaming wild boars.
